programs.title: Spinning cube
programs.description: The hello world of PolyBasic 3D: a camera, a light and a textured cube turning in Update().

programs.title: Block Rain
programs.description: A small game: dodge the falling blocks. Types, For Each, input, and a 2D score on top.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD, or drag with the mouse or a finger; Space or a tap to start

programs.title: Orbits
programs.description: Parents and children: a moon turns around a planet that turns around a sun.
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the camera, mouse wheel zooms

programs.title: Coin Hop
programs.description: A small platformer with glTF models by Kenney: collisions keep the character on the platforms, and its walk, idle and jump animations come from the model file.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD run, Space jumps

programs.title: Crate Tower
programs.description: Physics: throw heavy balls at a tower of crates and watch it fall. The program gives things bodies; the physics engine does the rest.
programs.controls: Click or tap to throw, Left/Right turn the view, R builds a new tower

programs.title: Paint Shapes
programs.description: Picking: point at a shape to see its name, click to paint it. Labels follow the shapes with CameraProject.
programs.controls: Mouse or finger; right click or P switches the picking mode

programs.title: Language tour
programs.description: Variables, loops, functions, arrays, Types and Select, printed to the console.

programs.title: Bouncing balls (console)
programs.description: The Update/Draw frame loop without graphics: balls move in Update, Draw prints a report.
